engine: Godot 4.7.2 stable ed1daf0bf, Forward+, Windows (NVIDIA RTX 3090)
stage: views_source below, saved as build/play_views.gd in each checkout; tools/showcase/building-surfaces.tscn
views_script: Loads main.tscn with the arguments above, waits for world.time >= 2 s, turns the battle director off, then for each view sets world.cam focus_pos (-21.07, 0, 7.45) (the seed's playground lot, its middle), dist, target_dist, pitch_deg and yaw, waits 90 frames and while structure_view.warming(), and saves the root viewport after frame_post_draw. Views: close (15 m, pitch -42, yaw 0.7) and battle (55 m, pitch -44.1, yaw 0.7: RtsCamera.pitch_for(55) at the default zoom).

comparisons.layout: Two rows, before | after, 792 px halves: the close view scaled from 1600x900, and an unscaled 792x446 crop of the battle view centred on (800, 470), what a 1600x900 screen shows at the default zoom

notes: Before is main as merged into this branch (f48b0f43), after is the branch with both design passes (430e48ed). Same map, same seed; the playground lot on seed 3 is 14.5 m by 14.5 m, where the layout is as it was, so only the equipment and the spring riders differ.
composition: PIL: comparison rows labelled in Arial Narrow, JPEG quality 82; the studio playground cropped to (70, 160, 1530, 840) and scaled to 1600 px wide, JPEG quality 84
